title: OpenAI Codex 'pets' overlay and migration importer
summary: OpenAI added a /pet and /hatch command set to Codex that spawns an animated desktop companion showing live agent status (active thread, running, waiting, ready for review). A separate migration system imports settings, plugins, agents and project configurations from other tools into Codex.

research.notes: Feature described in transcript; verify in official OpenAI Codex changelog.
